questions.q_en:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

As newspapers began to reach broader segments of the population, the aversion to reporting on domestic matters lingered.
questions.solution_en:
The most appropriate antonym for the word 'aversion' is 'propensity'. "Aversion" means a strong dislike or avoidance of something. In the given sentence, "aversion" suggests a strong dislike or reluctance towards reporting on domestic matters. 'Propensity' is the opposite of "aversion." It means a habitual attraction to some activity or thing.

'Rancor' means a deep-seated ill will.

'Malice' refers to the intention or desire to do evil; ill will.

'Revulsion' means a dislike so strong as to cause stomach upset or queasiness.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

'Reminiscent' means provoking a memory or mental association.

'Evocative' means provoking a memory or mental association.

'Nimble' means quick and agile in movement or action. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: But this servant then met a fellow servant who owed him a trifling sum.

questions.q_en:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

The positive reviews amplified the restaurant's popularity, while the negative ones __________ its reputation.
questions.solution_en:
Let's look at the meanings of the given options.

Complemented: to make something else seem better or more attractive when combined with it.

Propagated: to produce a new plant using a parent plant.

Tarnished: make or become less valuable or respected.

Propelled: drive or push something forwards.

In this sentence, "amplified" means to increase the effect of something. The antonym for "amplified" is "tarnished", which means to damage or destroy the quality or reputation of something.

So, the sentence becomes: "The positive reviews amplified the restaurant's popularity, while the negative ones tarnished its reputation".

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.
